subject: Aurelia onboarding acceleration — one-off credit escalation
thread_content:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@aureliatherapeutics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Accelerated onboarding ask + request for upfront credit

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. The team is aligned on Redwood’s performance, and we want to move the proof-of-concept forward more quickly than our usual cadence. To clear internal procurement and finance gates, they are asking for a one-time acceleration credit to cover the onboarding ramp (estimated token consumption during implementation and initial trials).

Key ask:
- One-time credit of $50k to offset POC consumption, applied against first invoice.
- Term: 12 months; we will commit to a 6-month minimum active use and provide a pilot success metric (latency/SLA) to release the remainder.

I’ve attached our updated internal proposal and a preliminary procurement note (attached: aurelia-proposal-v2.pdf). Procurement copied here (procurement@aureliatherapeutics.com) for tracking.

Can you confirm whether this is something Redwood can do, and what approvals are needed on your side? We’re hoping to close paperwork next week.

Best,
Oliver Grant
Sr. Dir., Product | Aurelia Therapeutics

---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Accelerated onboarding ask + request for upfront credit

Team — forwarding Aurelia’s request. Summary below, and I’ve attached the pricing workbook and a short memo with my recommended structure (one-off credit that steps down if POC metrics not met).

Why I’m escalating:
- High strategic fit (healthcare vertical, potential multi-year ARR).
- Short closing window; procurement needs a decision by EOW.
- Credit request (one-time $50k) is outside standard AE approval limits.

Proposed internal structure (recommended):
- One-time credit cap: $50,000 applied to first invoice.
- Release schedule: 50% at contract signing, 50% released after POC success metric (90th percentile latency < 350ms and no data isolation issues).
- Contingency: If POC not active for 90 days, remaining credit is recaptured as a prepaid credit on their account (not refundable).

Attachments: pricing-workbook-aurelia.xlsx, one-off-credit-memo-jb.pdf

Please let me know if you need a tighter guardrail or an alternative (e.g., discounted pilot rate rather than credit). If Laura can sign off, I’ll convey to procurement and get DocuSign ready.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0123

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Accelerated onboarding ask + request for upfront credit

Jordan — thanks for the context and the memo. A couple of quick questions before I move to finance:
1) Is the $50k meant purely to cover token consumption? Or are they expecting Redwood to cover integration engineering time? The proposal PDF is a bit ambiguous.
2) Do we have a precedent (last 12 months) for a one-off credit of this size for LOE claims? I can search the ledger but want your take.

Alternative we could offer: a 40% starter credit capped at $35k + a fast-track support add-on at a discounted hourly rate. That keeps the outlay lower but gives them runway. If we structure it as a credit that’s reclaimed unless success metrics are hit, we should be OK, but finance will want firm metric definitions and a rollback clause.

If you can confirm the scope (token vs. services) and the expected timeline for POC activation, I’ll draft the conditional credit language for Laura.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Accelerated onboarding ask + request for upfront credit

Marissa — good questions. Short answers:
- Aurelia expects the credit to cover platform consumption (tokens/embeddings) during the POC window. They will handle implementation with their systems integrator; Redwood will provide standard onboarding support included in our commercial package. I’ll confirm in writing to procurement.
- Precedent: We had two similar one-off onboarding credits in the past 12 months (one at $30k, one at $45k) tied to enterprise pilots; both were structured as conditional credits. I can pull the specific deals if you want.

Given the strategic fit and likelihood of expansion, I still favor the $50k conditional path but I’m open to the capped $35k + support discount if Finance prefers the smaller outlay.

Proposed metric language (for Marissa/Laura to refine):
- Pilot active timeline: POC window = 90 days from contract effective date with a minimum of 30 days of steady traffic (>= 1k requests/day).
- Success criteria: 90th percentile inference latency < 350ms AND at least one integration flow successfully writing to their analytics pipeline (proof-of-integration ticket closed).
- Credit release schedule: 25% at signing, 50% upon meeting latency + integration criteria, 25% retained as customer success holdback and released after 6 months of active usage.

I’ll confirm scope with Oliver and ask procurement to clarify the services ask.

—Jordan

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Accelerated onboarding ask + request for upfront credit

Team — reviewed Jordan’s memo and the attachments. I’m willing to approve a constrained, conditional one-off credit but with tighter limits:
- Approved: one-time credit up to $40,000 (not $50k).
- Conditions: credit structured exactly as Marissa drafts; we require the success metrics in writing and an explicit rollback clause that converts unreleased credit to a prepaid account balance (non-refundable).
- Contract clause: Credit terminates if POC not active within 120 days of signing.

Rationale: strategic upside is clear but we should reduce downside risk. If Jordan wants to push to $50k, have him prepare an explicit upside case (pipeline motion + 18-month revenue forecast) for sign-off by the CFO.

Marissa — please draft the conditional credit language and I’ll sign the approval memo. Jordan — I’ll need the final HubSpot deal ID and the draft SOW before I execute.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
VP Finance, Redwood Inference

---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@aureliatherapeutics.com>, procurement@aureliatherapeutics.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerated onboarding ask + request for upfront credit

Oliver — quick update from our side: Finance has approved a conditional one-time credit up to $40k. The credit will be governed by a short amendment with measurable success criteria and a rollback clause. Marissa will send the exact language today and Laura will sign once the HubSpot deal ID and SOW are attached.

Can you confirm that the credit only needs to cover platform consumption (not professional services)? If yes, I’ll have legal and procurement circulate the amendment by EOD and we can aim for signatures next week.

Appreciate the quick turn.
—Jordan
